MEMB.description: PSC Composite Section Member for Design (MEMB). Fields define the group of elements forming one PSC design member (segment) and its construction-joint type; element list and joint type drive the record.

AELEM.description: Element ID list forming this PSC design member. Every ID must reference an existing element. Requires at least 1 element when ELEM_MEMBER is true, otherwise at least 2 elements.

ELEM_MEMBER.description: Allow a single-element member. When true, AELEM may contain a single element; when false, AELEM must contain at least 2 elements.

JOINT_TYPE.description: Construction joint type: 0 = Resin, 1 = Cement. Must be 0 or 1.
